entities.name: Fall of Soldev
entities.description: Event on Terisiare in 2954 AR in which the city of Soldev was destroyed.

entities.name: Soldev
entities.description: City of machinists on Terisiare, destroyed in 2954 AR.

entities.name: Soldevi Adnates
entities.description: Group led by Jaya Ballard possessed by Mairsil-Lim-Dul who accessed the vaults beneath Soldev.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: Planeswalker possessed by the spirit of Mairsil-Lim-Dul who leads the adnates.

entities.name: Mairsil-Lim-Dul
entities.description: Spirit possessing Jaya; destroyed when her spark erupts.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Brought to Soldev; his blood activates the war beasts, and he confronts Jaya.

entities.name: Varchild
entities.description: Kjeldoran general falsely claimed to be marching on Soldev.

entities.name: Phyrexian War Beasts
entities.description: Excavated Phyrexian beasts kept in vaults beneath Soldev.

entities.name: Soldevi Steam Beasts
entities.description: Soldev's machines, secretly reprogrammed by the adnates.

entities.name: School of the Unseen
entities.description: Site with a bottomless pit also destroyed.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: His or Mishra's power was in Jodah's blood.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: His or Urza's power was in Jodah's blood.

events.summary: Jaya, possessed by Mairsil, warns Arcum of a false danger from General Varchild as a distraction.
events.quote: This was a lie to create a distraction while Jaya effectuated her plans.

events.summary: Arcum sends all the steam beasts out to hunt for Varchild; they return to find Soldev falling to ruin.
events.quote: Finding nothing, they returned to Soldev only to find it falling to ruin.

events.summary: Jaya and the adnates use Jodah's blood to activate the Phyrexian war beasts; Jodah nearly dies but heals himself.
events.quote: Jodah came within a heartbeat of dying from this process

events.summary: War beasts and steam beasts overwhelm the city until Jodah confronts Jaya.
events.quote: The city was quickly overwhelmed by the combined powers of the war beasts and the steam beasts

events.summary: Jaya sends the beasts into the bottomless pit at the School of the Unseen, destroying it.
events.quote: Jaya then went on to send the war beasts and steam beasts to the bottomless pit in the School of the Unseen

events.summary: In the duel, Jaya's spark erupts, destroying Mairsil and razing Soldev with a two-day firestorm.
events.quote: destroying Mairsil and creating a massive column of a firestorm that lasted for two full days

relations.quote: led by Jaya Ballard possessed by the spirit of Mairsil - Lim-Dûl
